rules.description: Every shortlisted candidate meets the role's must-haves: both must-have skills, the minimum relevant experience (R1 36 months of software engineering, R2 36 months of data analytics, R3 24 months of information security) and, for R3, a CISSP or CompTIA Security+ certificate on record.
Every shortlisted R3 candidate holds a CISSP or CompTIA Security+ certificate that is still valid on Monday 16 November 2026, the first interview day.

Nobody who needs visa sponsorship is shortlisted for a role that requires existing work authorization: R1 and R3, and R2 too unless it is hired through an employer of record (from medium on); legal requirement.
A candidate appears on at most one role's shortlist.
No shortlisted candidate applied after Wednesday 21 October 2026, the closing date of the job ads.

Among candidates qualified for at least one role they applied to, no gender, age-band or nationality group with 15 or more qualified candidates has a selection rate below 0.8 x the highest group's rate for that attribute with a gap to that group that a two-sided Fisher exact test finds significant (p < 0.05) (legal requirement; protected attributes must not drive the ranking).
Every referred candidate who is qualified for a role they applied to is shortlisted (for one such role).
